tools.name: search_servers
tools.description: Search MCP servers tested by TestedMCP by name, package or category. Results sorted by score.

tools.name: get_score
tools.description: Score (0-100), per-test results and evidence, and test date for one MCP server.

tools.name: is_deprecated
tools.description: Deprecation status, npm's exact deprecation message (null if none) and verification date.

tools.name: get_replacement
tools.description: Maintained replacement for a deprecated MCP server, only when there is evidence (e.g. npm's message); otherwise 'none identified'.
